title: Gender-Inclusive Grammatical Error Correction through Augmentation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) model performance (F0.5 scores) on parallel test sets containing singular 'they' pronouns versus masculine and feminine terms, alongside qualitative analysis of explicit bias instances such as misgendering (replacing 'they' with a gendered pronoun) or erasure (pluralizing referents of singular 'they').
